_why: Paths whose markdown links resolve from the REPOSITORY ROOT rather than from the folder the file sits in, because that is where the document renders. Read by check-doc-links.mjs, which lives in claude-skills/tools/ (public, no token) since buses-data OA-246 and resolves its corpus from the repository it is run FROM. This repository declares no `dirs`, which means the widest scope: its whole tree. See buses-data OA-227 and OA-246.
